question: What do the two absorptions accomplish without firm establishment in the non-conceptual?
premises: Both absorptions are directed toward the ocean of the non-conceptual.
Their orientation alone is not the same as stable realization.
Without firm establishment in that non-conceptual state, no real attainment occurs.
inference: Although both absorptions aim at the non-conceptual, they accomplish nothing without firm establishment in it.
uncertainties: The identity of the two samāveśas is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Both of these absorptions are indeed directed toward the ocean of the non-conceptual; but without firm establishment in that, nothing at all is truly accomplished.
